final: WITH counts AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.order_type_mix, c.record_count, 1.0 * c.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.order_type_mix, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - m.value FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value
